comment: ADR-004 bootstrap: prebuilt LGPL libmpv used by lane B1 until mediahro-deps archives are pinned in deps.lock. Only the engine workflow and local development fetch these; app builds bundle libmpv from .deps-cache/<target> (deps.lock) only. The media_kit variants are the LGPL "full" builds (all decoders/demuxers); all are LGPL builds (no encoders-gpl, no GPL configure flags).

android-arm64-v8a.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)

android-armeabi-v7a.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)

android-x86_64.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)

macos-dylibs.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)

macos-xcframeworks.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)

ios-xcframeworks.licence: LGPL (media_kit 'full' variant: FFmpeg --disable-gpl/--enable-version3 with all decoders and demuxers; no GPL inputs)
